title: Profound UI Rich Display File
description: Structural schema for a Profound UI Rich Display File saved as JSON. This schema validates file shape only — it does not validate property names or values against the widget property catalog. Use the skill's validator for that level of checking.

text.description: Human-readable description of the display file.

formats.description: One or more record formats. Each is a DDS-style screen layout.

long name aliases.description: Whether long field-name aliases are enabled. Usually true.

overlay.description: DDS OVERLAY keyword. String, not real boolean.

overlay range.description: Row range the format occupies, e.g. "1-20".

onload.description: JavaScript run when the format renders.

id.description: Unique element id within the file.

field type.description: Widget type. See reference/widgets/ for the list.

layout.description: Id of a parent layout item (if this item is nested in a layout).

container.description: 1-based slot index inside the parent layout.

grid.description: Id of a parent grid item (if this item is a column template in a grid).

column.description: 0-based column index inside the parent grid.

dspfRecordLayout.description: Map of record-format-name -> ordered list of field buffer-position entries.

name.description: Field name. May be "*inNN" for legacy indicator-style references.

inBufPos.description: 1-based input buffer position. Omit for output-only fields.

outBufPos.description: 1-based output buffer position. Omit for input-only fields.

boundFieldValue.description: A property value that is a data binding to an IBM i program field. Different data types use different keys, but all share fieldName.

fieldName.description: Field name. Supports "NN", "NNN", "*inNN" for indicators (N prefix negates). Any string for named fields.
